implementers.role: Acquirer at launch

implementers.name: Checkout.com
implementers.role: Acquirer at launch; Latin American enabling partner

implementers.name: Citi
implementers.role: One of the two first US issuers in Mastercard's 2025-09-10 plan; Mastercard's CEO said on 2025-10-30 that its cardholders can now use Agent Pay

implementers.name: U.S. Bank
implementers.role: One of the two first US issuers in Mastercard's 2025-09-10 plan; Mastercard's CEO said on 2025-10-30 that its cardholders can now use Agent Pay

implementers.name: Majid Al Futtaim and Dataiera
implementers.role: UAE pilot partners; Mastercard called the 2025-11-19 UAE transaction Agent Pay's first outside the US

implementers.name: Garanti BBVA
implementers.role: Showed an AI shopping assistant built with reference to Agent Pay's principles on 2025-12-23 (a demo, which Garanti BBVA and Mastercard called Türkiye's first end-to-end agentic commerce transaction in banking)

implementers.name: Shopify (Shop Pay)
implementers.role: Shop Pay checkout in personal AI agents (Shopify's Fall '26 Edition, 2026-10-28); Shopify says agent purchases from merchants off Shopify use Mastercard, Visa and Discover tokens. Mastercard's CEO said on 2026-10-29 that Shop Pay uses Agent Pay (reported); Shopify does not name Agent Pay

implementers.name: OpenAI
implementers.role: Broad strategic partnership that includes the use of Agent Pay, per Mastercard's CEO on the Q3 2026 call (2026-10-29, reported); on the Q1 2026 call (2026-04-30) he had said Mastercard was deepening the partnership, which he said reinforces OpenAI's use of Agent Pay (reported, transcripts only). No written statement from either company was found as of 2026-11-14

implementers.name: ChatGPT Wallet (OpenAI)
implementers.role: Rolling out since 2026-11-13 to US ChatGPT Pro subscribers in dots, with payment tokens that OpenAI's post says the payment network provides and that work in existing checkout flows. As read 2026-11-21, OpenAI's post names American Express, Chase, Mastercard and Visa as partners, where the launch-day text named three; Chase takes part as a card issuer (eligible Chase credit cards, primary cardholder only). No Mastercard program is named, so a link to Agent Pay is unconfirmed

implementers.name: Travelport, Booked AI and Basis Theory
implementers.role: Live end-to-end agentic flight purchase announced on 2026-11-12: Booked AI's agent, an NDC offer through Travelport TripServices, Agent Pay with a tokenized credential, the card held in Basis Theory's vault, and Verifiable Intent linking the customer's approval; airline unnamed

implementers.name: Ant International (Antom)
implementers.role: Acceptance partner in a live coffee purchase that, per Mastercard, ran on Agent Pay with Verifiable Intent on the consumer's pre-captured intent, and partner in a completed AP4M pilot in Singapore (both announced 2026-11-19). The merchant, the market of the coffee purchase and any volume are not named; Ant International was also an AP4M Early Access pilot partner

implementers.name: Temu
implementers.role: Memorandum of understanding announced 2026-11-18 to evaluate more Mastercard solutions, including Click to Pay, and to explore agentic commerce through Agent Pay; Temu already replaces saved card numbers with Mastercard tokens. No date, market or product detail for Agent Pay

implementers.name: Rakuten Mobile
implementers.role: Memorandum of understanding, announced 2026-11-19, to explore integrating its Travel eSIM Platform with Agent Pay, shown in a live demonstration at the Singapore FinTech Festival 2026; no launch date

implementers.name: Yeahka (YeahPay)
implementers.role: Cooperation agreement at the Singapore FinTech Festival 2026, per Yeahka (2026-11-19): YeahPay is to process Agent Pay transactions started in what Yeahka calls the Mastercard App, shown with a bubble tea demonstration; no launch date, and no Mastercard copy found

implementers.name: lobster.cash (Crossmint)
implementers.role: Plans announced 2026-04-16 to integrate Agent Pay and Verifiable Intent, first for OpenClaw agents through an early access program; every lobster.cash Agent Pay transaction is to use Verifiable Intent, with Basis Theory as the credential layer. Not shown live as of 2026-11-21

implementers.name: PayOS
implementers.role: Orchestrator of live agentic transactions: its own claimed first live payment with a Mastercard Agentic Token (2025-10-01), Santander's transaction and the European banks' controlled transactions

implementers.name: PayPal
implementers.role: Wallet integration; pilots the Acceptance Framework

implementers.name: Cloudflare
implementers.role: Edge verification of agent signatures; AP4M end-to-end pilot partner, returning 402 through Cloudflare Monetization Gateway in the 2026-10-20 demo

implementers.name: Stripe
implementers.role: Shared Payment Tokens carry Mastercard agentic network tokens

implementers.name: Santander
implementers.role: What Santander and Mastercard called Europe's first live end-to-end agent payment (controlled)

implementers.name: Commonwealth Bank of Australia and Westpac
implementers.role: What Mastercard called Australia's first authenticated agentic transactions (controlled trials)

implementers.name: Selected Asia-Pacific and EEMEA issuers (Westpac New Zealand, Axis Bank, RBL Bank, DBS, UOB, CIMB, RHB, HSBC, DBS Hong Kong, Krungthai Card, PrivatBank, maib, Moldindconbank)
implementers.role: Agentic transactions that Mastercard announced as firsts, or controlled pilots, 2026-02 to 2026-07

metrics.metric: Agent Pay transaction volume or value
metrics.definition: Count or value of Agent Pay transactions.
metrics.caveat: No Mastercard release reports counts or values, including the 2026-11-19 Antom release, and the earnings releases for the fourth quarter of 2025 and the first and third quarters of 2026, the Q3 2026 presentation, supplemental data and Form 10-Q give no agentic figure. On the calls the CEO said volumes were still at an early stage (2026-04-30) and the numbers not yet significant but growing weekly (2026-10-29), both reported. The 2026-10-20 AP4M brief counts only the nine payments in its demo.

metrics.metric: European banks with completed controlled live transactions
metrics.definition: Banks named by Mastercard as completing controlled live agentic transactions on Priceless.com.

metrics.metric: Latin American issuers and processors with live transactions
metrics.definition: Named participants completing live agentic transactions.
Organizations named in the AP4M launch release.
metrics.caveat: Includes Mastercard Merchant Cloud; announced support, not live usage.
Interest signal only; no commits since 2026-04-20.

metrics.metric: Consumers projected to use agents routinely by 2030
metrics.definition: Mastercard projection of routine agent purchasing.
metrics.caveat: Projection; the release does not give its method.

costs.caveat: Secondary review by Nevermined, an AP4M participant.

costs.item: Agent-specific interchange, token fee, liability rule or reason code
costs.value: None public; the Mastercard Agent Pay Program Standards that the Mastercard Rules (2026-06-02) require are not public
costs.whoPays: Not stated; no agent fee found
costs.caveat: No agentic interchange category or token fee was found. A May 2026 merchant-cost note expects new fee categories but names none. Mastercard says standard chargeback rights apply; Worldpay (2026-07-30) says no liability shift exists yet.

costs.value: Tokens accepted through existing processors; PCI scope unchanged
costs.whoPays: Merchant pays its existing acquirer fees
costs.caveat: Mastercard describes no extra merchant fee; that is an absence of a statement, not a statement of zero fees.

costs.value: Sellers on Stripe support agentic network tokens automatically; no Agent Pay-specific Stripe price stated
costs.whoPays: Not stated; Stripe prices SPTs per SPT issued
costs.caveat: Stripe's US pricing page lists Shared Payment Tokens at 0.15 USD per SPT issued, listed since at least 2026-04-23; it does not name the party billed or say how the price applies to Agent Pay tokens.
Neither the 2026-06-10 announcement nor the 2026-10-20 Early Access brief gives pricing; the Early Access documentation is not public. Settlement costs per rail not published.
